fnol_text: My name is Hannah Osei and I live at 401 Larkspur Drive, Salem, MA 01940. You can reach me on (555) 216-3980 or hannah.osei@example.com. We had a cloudburst on 21 October 2026. The drains in the street could not cope and surface water from the road came up the drive and into the ground floor through the front door. Policy HH-2025-00104. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Osei on (555) 216-3980 to acknowledge the claim. Hannah confirmed the loss date as 21 October 2026.
Site visit to 401 Larkspur Drive. Neighbour Amara Vasquez was present and confirmed the timeline.
Hannah sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
